description: For bots that watch for liquidation: every short and USDG loan of a wallet, worst first, with how much of its limit it uses (limit_used, 1 = Morpho can liquidate it now), health (1 / limit_used), the stock price that liquidates it, how far the price is from that in percent, a status (ok, warn from 0.85, danger from 0.95, liquidatable), and the market clock. Also at /health/<wallet>.json.

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: health
title: Health and liquidation prices
